test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 17 Jan 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A can run 1 km in 4 min, and B can cover the same distance in 4 min 10 sec. By what distance can A beat B in a 1 km race?
solution:
**Given Data:**

A runs 1 km in 4 min.

B runs 1 km in 4 min 10 sec.

**Concept:**

Distance = Speed × Time

**Solution:**

4 min = 240 sec. & 4 min 10 sec = 250 sec.

A covers 1 km in 240 sec, B covers 1 km in 250 sec, 

Speed of B ⇒ 1km/250sec = 1000meter/250sec = 4 m/sec. 

Difference of Time between A & B = 250 - 240 = 10 sec.

A can beat B 10 sec prior,

Distance = 4 × 10 = 40 m.

**∴ A beat B by 40 m.**
